title: A package in two files
hints: You only need to edit `convert.go`. Both files say `package temperature`, so they see each other's names.
`c*9/5 + 32` is evaluated left to right: `c*9` is a `float64`, so the division that follows is floating-point too.
`FToC` is `(f - 32) * 5 / 9`. Avoid `5/9 * (f - 32)`: `5/9` is an untyped integer constant expression equal to `0`.
